newsitem.title: UK: European cotton mills make isolated nearby purchases.
newsitem.headline: European cotton mills make isolated nearby purchases.

text.p: Most mills in Western Europe adhered to the sidelines in the absence of new stimulus, traders said.
But occasional sales were recorded particularly in Portugal, Italy and Germany notably in African upland and Central Asian medium/better qualities available for nearby delivery.
Forward enquiry was generally lacking and in Eastern Europe, enquiry was largely of a price testing nature embracing long staple varieties.
